method: Only source RGBA core pixels with Alpha >= 230; no background composite and no transparent RGB. CIE Lab D65 via linear sRGB. Percentiles and threshold coverage are measured per anatomy region. Texture measures are indicative because strand widths/directions vary.
ornament_exclusion: Front layers contain no ornaments. Back measurements start y190 or lower, below wood pin/high cloth wrap and knot. Decorative parts are excluded rather than made hair-color targets.

limitations: This is a tone baseline, not an exact shape or strand-texture equivalence test.
Female style02 is a low bun without long rear curtain; it is excluded from pooled nape and rear-curtain targets, but its individual statistics remain recorded.
Back scalp interior is often hidden; visual judgement should prioritize exposed cap, side hair and front/chest strands.
Low chroma makes hue angle unstable; use Lab a/b and mean RGB channel differences for hue matching.
Opaque core statistics do not evaluate soft alpha edge haze, which still needs light/dark composite inspection.
